title: Best Photo Preset Creators (2026): Custom Lightroom Presets
description: How to hire a photo preset creator for custom Lightroom or mobile presets: consistent looks, files, how to brief it, what drives the price and red flags.
intro: Photo preset creators build custom editing settings, such as Lightroom presets and mobile filters, that give your photos a consistent look in one click. Brands, photographers and creators use them to keep feeds, product photos and portfolios recognizable. Projects go wrong when presets only work on the sample photos, skin tones look wrong, or files do not install in your app. This guide helps you get presets that work on your real photos.

faq.q: Will a preset work on every photo?
faq.a: Not perfectly. Lighting and cameras vary, so small adjustments are normal. Good presets are tested on many different photos.
Common formats work in desktop and mobile versions of popular editing apps. Confirm the app and version you use.

faq.q: How many presets do I need?
faq.a: Often a few variations: bright, indoor, outdoor and portraits. Several versions handle different lighting better.
Only if the agreement allows it. Agree on personal, commercial or resale use.
A selection of your own photos in different lighting, ideally original files, plus examples of the look you like.
